verdict.rationale: IP India runs an online e-filing and account-based service, so exporting a user's own data is a fair question to ask. The evidence covers public search, status tracking, e-registers and downloadable forms and fees. None of it documents a way for users to export all their filings or account data in open formats, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
